text: Cryptographic hashing makes blockchain manipulation immediately detectable because the hash incorporates all previous transactions, so that even a single digit change produces a different hash value.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds

abstract: The smallest change to the blockchain, even a single digit/value, results in a different hash value. A different hash value makes any form of manipulation immediately detectable.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: chained hashing that incorporates all prior transactions
